7600 / 8600: Cortech Endurance All Purpose Wall Mount Shelf / Step
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-7600-8600-endurance-all-purpose-wall-mount-shelf-step
Manufacturer pages: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/shelving/endurance-all-purpose-shelf/, https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/shelving/endurance-all-purpose-shelf-2-0/
Spec sheets: 7600, 8600, Installation 7600, Installation 8600
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance All Purpose Wall Mount Shelf / Step – 7600 / 8600
Current H1: Cortech Endurance - All Purpose Wall Mount Shelf / Step - Models 7600 & 8600
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Wall Shelf That Can Also Be Installed as a Step to an Upper Bunk
Current subtitle: Cortech USA Endurance All Purpose Wall Mount Shelf / Step 7600 / 8600
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance All Purpose Wall Mount Shelf / Step is a small molded shelf that bolts to the wall in cells and patient rooms. It can hold a TV, books, or small belongings, or be installed as a step for climbing onto an upper Endurance Wall Bunk.
The shelf is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It comes in two sizes: the 7600 and the larger 8600 Shelf 2.0. Installed with the angled side facing up, it gives a steadier foot placement as a step and helps reduce ligature risk.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Shelf or Step: As a shelf, install with the angled side facing down; as a step, or to reduce ligature risk, turn it 180° so the angled side faces up
Dimensions: 15”W×6”D×5”H (7600) or 16”W×10”D×8”H (8600)
Weight: 2½ lbs (7600) or 4 lbs (8600)
Mounting: Bolts to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
7600 – All Purpose Shelf: 15”W×6”D×5”H, 2½ lbs
8600 – All Purpose Shelf 2.0: Larger size, 16”W×10”D×8”H, 4 lbs
Installation and Options
Wall Mounting: Bolt to the wall through concealed pilot holes; Cortech instructions show three (7600) or four (8600) 3/8”-16×2½” tamper-proof security Torx anchor bolts
Direction: Angled side down for use as a shelf; angled side up for use as a step or to reduce ligature risk
[H2] Applications
The All Purpose Shelf / Step suits rooms that need a small fixed shelf, or a safe step up to an upper wall bunk.
Typical applications include:
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Rooms with Endurance Wall Bunks, as a step to the upper bunk
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (62 characters): Cortech Endurance Wall Shelf / Step - 7600 / 8600 at Anchortex
Meta description (148 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance All Purpose Shelf. A one-piece molded wall shelf in two sizes that can also be installed as a step to an upper wall bunk.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out the dash after "Endurance" and changed "Models 7600 & 8600" to the model numbers at the end.
Weight: your variants are set to 3 lbs (7600) and 5 lbs (8600). The Cortech spec sheets say 2.5 lbs and 4 lbs, so I used those.
Variant names: your variants are "7600 - Step" and "8600 - Step 2.0." Cortech calls them the All Purpose Shelf and All Purpose Shelf 2.0. Would you like them renamed, for example "7600 - Shelf / Step"?
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I added it.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
I left out "Stain resistant," since the Cortech spec sheets do not say this.
Product images: the page has four images: three photos of the 7600 and the older color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like the chart replaced?
